label: NUP98::DDX10

sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.
DDX10 encodes a DEAD-box RNA helicase implicated in ribosome biogenesis.

The fusion retains the amino-terminal FG-repeat region of NUP98 and creates an abnormal transcriptional regulator associated with sustained HOX-gene expression. The DDX10 partner contributes sequences from an RNA helicase; experimental models support leukemogenic transcriptional activity.
